|translation='''Title:''' Trample.

'''Card text:''' At the same outdoor location as your piloted AT-AT, target one character, crashed vehicle, or unpiloted vehicle with maneuver. Draw destiny. A character target is lost if destiny exceeds ability. A vehicle target is lost if destiny is less than 7.

'''Lore:''' The walker's enormous feet are designed to step across a variety of terrain. Ruthless pilots use them to literally crush the Rebellion.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face names a piloted AT-AT.
|notes='''Trample (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Trample|Trample]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Trample (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R42 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R42.
